The '''Department of Modification''' was a department of the [[Coalition for Improvements/Legends|Coalition for Improvements]]' [[Sector Development]]. Its public face was as an association of technologists and specialists who strove to help [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] modify their technology to fall in line with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] standard. However, they were also responsible for modifying social conditions and institutions on the planet to better conform to [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] ideology, thereby increasing the loyalty of the citizens. Members of the Department of Modification would promote the achievements and careers of those individuals who were politically in line with the New Order, then create subtle problems that only their chosen individuals&mdash;with the Department's assistance&mdash;could solve.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a survey group from the department was sent to [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] to assess whether or not the system could supply materials to construct a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="J1">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>
